name: The Prince's Keeper
source:
Play as the newest servant to Prince Railan—who’s had all of his previous servants fired. While navigating your position, you’ll try to pry down his carefully guarded walls as you challenge him on everything he believes about himself and the world.

Just try to not get fired in the process. 

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/the-princes-keeper]itch.io[/url]]
